snippet.title: Project Z - First Video
snippet.description:
Project Z is a small puzzle game targeting Oculus Go that I have been working on and off for the last 6 months or so.
Graphics are still very much work in progress ;).
This video was recorded directly on the Oculus Go and somehow it looks like it is stuttering a bit. I was playing at mostly stable 72fps though.
It is using my custom game engine "Rayne" with a Vulkan renderer I started developing specifically for the Go (but of course also works on other android, linux and windows) and I hope that I can still optimize things a little more.
